_comment: Resist! Mission cards. 20 total: Era 1 (8), Era 2 (6), Era 3 (6). Icon mapping (confirmed visually, verify vs rulebook component key): 'garrison' = card-stack icon = number of Enemy cards dealt to this Mission; 'defense' = numbered shield icon = Attack Strength required to defeat the Mission; 'victoryPoints' = laurel icon. 'keyword' is DEFEAT or DEFEND (skull marker = DEFEAT, shield marker = DEFEND). Transcribed from Era 1/2/3 Cards.jpg.

cards.name: Destroy the Barracks
cards.effect: Add a face-down Enemy to all other Missions.

cards.name: Cross the Border
cards.effect: Draw one fewer card from the Hidden deck during the Recover phase.

cards.name: Recon the Mountain Pass
cards.effect: Flip all Enemies at one Mission face-up.

cards.name: Attack Francoists in the Valley
cards.effect: Draw one extra card from the Hidden deck during the Recover phase.

cards.name: Destroy the Railroad Bridge
cards.effect: Discard one Enemy (face-up or face-down) from another Mission.

cards.name: Intercept the Commanding Officer
cards.effect: Remove one Spy in your hand from the game.

cards.name: Attack the Commander's Villa
cards.effect: For each undefeated Enemy at this Mission, draw a card from the Civilian deck and place it face-up in the Graveyard.

cards.name: Destroy the Bunker
cards.effect: When this Mission is chosen, immediately choose a Maquis card (not a Spy) from your hand and discard it.

cards.name: Destroy the Supply Convoy
cards.effect: Discard one Enemy (face-up or face-down) from each other Mission.

cards.name: Jailbreak at the Prison
cards.effect: Draw a card from the Recruit deck and place it in the Hidden discard pile.

cards.name: Attack the Counter-Guerrilla Headquarters
cards.effect: For each undefeated Enemy at this Mission, draw a card from the Civilian deck and place it face-up in the Graveyard.

cards.name: Retreat to the Caves
cards.effect: Add a new Spy card to the Hidden discard pile.

cards.name: Take Back the Farmhouse
cards.effect: Choose a card from the Revealed pile and place it in the Hidden discard pile.

cards.name: Steal Supplies from the Train Depot
cards.effect: Maquis cannot be revealed during the ATTACK phase of the round when this Mission is chosen.

cards.name: Defend the Farmhouse
cards.effect: Shuffle all hidden Maquis in play and remove one from the game.

cards.name: Destroy the Train Depot
cards.effect: Only one Maquis may be revealed during the ATTACK phase of the round when this Mission is chosen.

cards.name: Defend the Crossroads
cards.effect: When this Mission is chosen, immediately discard all Maquis in play.

cards.name: Attack the Police Station
cards.effect: Look at the top three cards of the Hidden deck. Put any Spies back on top and discard the rest.

cards.name: Attack the Mayor's House
cards.effect: All Enemies at this Mission gain 1 Defense.

cards.name: Attack Franco's Headquarters
cards.effect: For each undefeated Enemy at this Mission, draw a card from the Civilian deck and place it face-up in the Graveyard.
